messages:
maria (support): Heads up — customer ACME reports their 'Requests per minute' chart goes blank when they switch region from `us-west` to `eu-central` on a saved dashboard. It comes back after ~30s. Happened twice this morning.

jeff (telemetry): Can you paste account id + dashboard id and any UI trace id? Also good to know whether they have personal filter overrides.

maria (support): account=acct_12xyz, dashboard=dash_84b, ui_trace=ui_01F7ABCD. Repro steps below.

maria (support): ```
1) Open saved dashboard (dash_84b)
2) Switch region filter from `us-west` -> `eu-central`
3) Chart shows "No data" (empty)
4) ~30s later chart repopulates
```

sandeep (eng-analytics): :eyes: Can you include the network tab payload for the metrics query? Curious if the client sent tenant or if server normalization changed the request mid-flight.

maria (support): Network request (trimmed):
```
POST /api/metrics/query
Headers: Authorization: Bearer xxxxx, X-Tenant: acct_12xyz
Body: {"range":"1h","filters":{"region":"eu-central"},"viz":"timeseries"}
```
Response was 200 with `rows: []` initially, then rows appeared on retry.

dana (ingest): We had a small Kafka consumer lag on metrics-topic-1 around 15:02-15:08 UTC (3-4k msgs). That could add delay but shouldn't cause region-specific blanks for a saved dashboard. Will correlate tenant offsets.

jeff (telemetry): Pulled query logs for dash_84b. I see two nearly-simultaneous queries: first with cache key A -> returned empty, second with cache key B -> returned rows. The only difference: key B included `org_default_region` flag.

sandeep (eng-analytics): Reproduced locally. Saved dashboards use a cache key that sometimes includes `org_default_region` when the org has a default set. The UI sends the client-selected region, then the server normalization layer applies org defaults and rewrites the effective filters, which changes the cache key. The first lookup misses, second executes and populates cache. UX impact: transient blank chart. Not data-loss. :grimacing:

maria (support): Customer wants to know if this is a bug and whether there's a workaround.

dana (ingest): Short-term workaround: open dashboard settings -> explicit filter in query (set region to `eu-central`) or clear personal/organization overrides. That prevents the normalization race. I'll draft steps we can send.

sandeep (eng-analytics): Filed ENG-ANALYTICS-3821 to unify cache keys (apply normalization before cache lookup) and avoid churn. I'll land a hotfix that ensures normalization happens prior to any cache decision. ETA: patch + canary tomorrow morning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-analytics/pull/471

maria (support): Thanks — I'll pass workaround + ETA to ACME and mark P2. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deployed canary normalization-fix to staging at 2024-03-12T02:00:00Z

sandeep (eng-analytics): Verified staging: couldn't reproduce blank-chart after staging deploy. Planning prod rollout after QA.

jeff (telemetry): Added a short-lived dashboard to monitor cache key churn per-tenant so we can detect regressions early.

maria (support): Closing loop with customer. They'll verify and reopen if needed. Thanks team! :pray:
